narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Each pyramid has five faces, so the octahedron has ten faces.
<bookmark mark='inside'/>The two squares are glued together inside. Nobody can touch them from outside.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A face must be on the outside, so the squares do not count.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Unfold each part flat, and keep the parts joined along an edge.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Only surfaces on the outside count as faces.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Plan a net of a tent shaped prism, and count its faces, edges and vertices.
